description: HQ Lite: web app, tasks, notes and MCP for locked-down computers
notes: Pinned to one signed main build; it is not updated automatically. For the newest build run the installer (irm https://agent-hq.online/install.ps1 | iex), which also verifies HQ's minisign signature. The build has no Windows code-signing certificate, so a computer that only allows approved programs may refuse to run it.
